train.text: The patient was prescribed 50mg of aspirin and subsequently developed a severe rash.
After taking 10ml of ibuprofen, the child reported feeling nauseous.
Administered lisinopril 20 mg daily; patient complained of dry cough.
Patient was given 2 puffs of albuterol. No side effects were reported.
Increased metformin to 1000 mg twice a day. The patient noted mild gastrointestinal upset.
She took a 200mg tablet of celecoxib and experienced sudden dizziness and blurry vision.
Applied 1% hydrocortisone cream to the affected area. Skin irritation worsened.
The subject ingested 5 mg of melatonin before bed and reported extreme morning grogginess.

test.text: Subject received 500mg of amoxicillin but presented with hives.
Discontinued the 50 mcg levothyroxine dose due to heart palpitations.
